card.name: Right before manifestation or presentation
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected "manifestation", "manifest", "presentation" or "forms", such as "the", "its", "initial" or the start of MANIFESTATION. It appears in clinical statements about how a condition shows itself.

modes.label: Start of manifest word
modes.description: The opening piece of MANIFESTATION or MANIFESTED in capitalized text, or a word cut partway through before "manifestations".
modes.example: THE CLINICAL<< MAN>>IFESTATION OF APLASTIC AN

modes.label: Linking word before presentation
modes.description: A small word or adjective such as "the", "initial" or "its" where the next word is likely "manifestation", "presentation" or "forms".
modes.example: may be the<< initial>> presentation of Bipolar Disorder

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like manifest, manifestation and expression, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say how a condition shows itself, as in "manifestation" or "presentation".
